## Lista06

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

1.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, min(acres) from preserve
group by state
```

2.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) from preserve
where acres <= 10000
group by state
```

3.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) from preserve
where acres <= 10000
group by state
order by max(acres) desc
```

4.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) as maxA from preserve
group by state
having maxA <= 25000
```

5.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, min(acres) as minA from preserve
group by state
having minA < 100
```

6.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, max(acres) as maxA from preserve 
where acres > 1000
group by state
having maxA < 25000
```

7.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, acres from preserve
where acres between 10000 and 50000
```

8.  

```{sql connection=con}
select state, avg(acres) as mean from preserve
group by state
order by mean
limit 1
```

9.  

```{sql connection=con}
select dno, avg(salary) as mean from employee
group by dno
```

10. 

```{sql connection=con}
select dno, sum(salary) as sumS, max(salary) as maxS, min(salary) as minS from employee
group by dno
```

11. 

```{sql connection=con}
select dno, count(ename) as n from employee
where dno <> 40
group by dno
```

12. 

```{sql connection=con}
select dno, sum(salary), count(ename) as n from employee
group by dno
having n > 2
```

13. 

```{sql connection=con}
select state, sum(acres) as Total from preserve
group by state

union all
select "Total", sum(acres) from preserve

```
